name: Raktabir Admin
tagline: Donor records, certificates & emergency finder for blood camps
description: Raktabir Admin is the volunteer tool used at the blood donation camps of Kalinga Humanitarian Aid Youth Federation. Record each donor with a photo, issue an instant certificate and share image with a verify QR, search the donor database by blood group, find eligible donors in an emergency, and post camps and notices that appear in the Kalinga Raktabir donor app. Works offline at camps and syncs when the network returns. For Federation volunteers.
features: New donor in seconds: camera photo, blood group, details, duplicate check by phone number
Instant certificate (A4 image or PDF) and social share image with a signed verify QR
Six colour themes including Tiranga, drawn digital signature for the President
Emergency finder: pick the blood group, include compatible groups, call or WhatsApp
Searchable donor database filtered by blood group
Eligibility reminders (90 days men, 120 days women) and milestone badges
Post camps, notices and community links for the donor app
Offline first with Supabase cloud sync, zip backup and restore, PIN lock

notes: Cloud sync across volunteer phones, camps and notices for the donor app
Updated privacy policy and terms covering cloud sync
